Validate a vector of UEIs

Source: R/utils.R
us_validate_uei.Rd

A SAM.gov Unique Entity Identifier is 12 alphanumeric characters. This checks shape only – it cannot tell you whether an entity exists.

Usage

us_validate_uei(uei, strict = TRUE)

Arguments

uei

Character vector of UEIs.

strict

If TRUE (default), malformed UEIs raise an error. If FALSE, they are returned as NA with a warning.

Value

Character vector of cleaned UEIs, same length as uei.

Examples

us_validate_uei("cffmypabyag3")
#> [1] "CFFMYPABYAG3"
